lead: Analysis of the rolling history reveals active customer acquisition and platform deployments across major EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors, led by Lufthansa Systems, Jeppesen, and IFS. Carrier adoption spans diverse business models, including LCCs and full-service carriers.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple EFB wins including LCC carriers
insights.finding: IFS secured key customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, including fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), with MY FREIGHTER classified as an LCC.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC by analyst review.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility indicates active customer announcements rather than complete market share.

insights.title: Thales and Aviobook secure Royal Air Maroc EFB agreement
insights.finding: Thales and Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service flag carrier.
insights.caveat: Based on a single captured contract announcement.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems deploys Lido Flight 4D to Kenya Airways
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems successfully implemented its Lido Flight 4D platform for Kenya Airways, providing flight planning and operational visibility.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways operates as a scheduled international full-service carrier.
insights.caveat: Implementation signals reflect captured corporate milestones.

insights.title: Jeppesen expands dispatch and flight planning footprint
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured major enterprise flight planning agreements, including a fleet-wide adoption with Korean Air and selection by Corendon Airlines as a launch customer.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air is a full-service global carrier; Corendon Airlines operates in the leisure and LCC space.
insights.caveat: Representative deals captured via official site sources.

insights.title: Navblue expands TransNusa partnership with Skywise suite
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by adopting Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ for integrated flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa is a regional/low-cost operating carrier in Southeast Asia.
insights.caveat: Expanded agreement represents a specific regional customer footprint.
